what_works: Place-anchored storytelling — Tasmanian highlands imagery and founder portraits position owners as stewards of the land. Black-and-white landscape shots break up muted color, giving the page a documentary editorial cadence.
what_does_not_translate: The terroir / 'custodians' poetry is a winery-specific frame; keep the founder-portrait + landscape pairing, drop the literary copy register.
type_observations: Contemporary sans-serif throughout; founder-quote pull-quotes set in larger weight to interrupt the rhythm. Generous whitespace.
